messages:
alex: quick ping — PR #2486 updates kvcache keys (small rename + fmt). CI is red on `go vet` linter, needs one more approval before I can merge. any volunteer to take a quick look? 🙏

mina: taking a look now, will post comments in PR.

taylor: i can approve if it's just naming+format, but what's the lint error?

ci-bot: CI failed — govet: ./runtime/kvcache/cache.go:45:2: exported method KVCacher.Get should have comment or be unexported

mina: ah that's the govet docstring nit. we can add a short comment. also one var rename i suggested inline.

alex: suggested fix in PR pushed: added doc comment + renamed kvCache -> kvStore per earlier discussion. also ran `gofmt -w .`

sam: quick read — lgtm. the rename is ok. two tiny nits: 1) make sure `kvStore` usage is consistent across callers, 2) consider a brief comment in cache_test.go explaining the test vector setup.

mina: small nit: i noticed one trailing space in cache_test.go, can you run `gofmt -w` (or re-run CI) so we get a clean diff?

alex: done, pushed formatting + fixed the trailing space. CI re-run.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green ✅

taylor: approving now. :shipit:

alex: thanks! merging in 5m during maintenance window. will watch oncall.

alex: merged and tagged. thanks everyone :tada:
